projectSummary.idea: Task manager prototype showcasing the clean-light "Продолжи" concept
projectSummary.stack: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, lucide-react
implementedFeatures: Single-page Kanban-style task dashboard rendered inside App.tsx with backlog through done columns
Interactive task cards featuring progress indicators, priority badges, due dates, and subtasks with checkbox controls
